title: Tilings of an equilateral triangle by at most five lattice trapezoids with 60° base angles: a complete structural classification
summary: We study tilings of an equilateral triangle of side n in the triangular grid by k lattice trapezoids with base angles 60°, the objects behind the OEIS sequences A389392 (k = 4) and A391498 (k = 5). We prove two angle identities valid for every such tiling and a lemma relating the number of boundary vertices to the number of pieces having a side on the boundary. With these tools we show that there are exactly 1, 2 and 13 combinatorial types of tilings for k = 3, 4, 5. For k = 3 every tiling is a pinwheel.
